pact_terms.anomalousclasses.isael: Vow of Dawn: Harming innocent villagers or non-aggressive golems weakens your faith. Real protection strengthens it. Signing Velkan at the same time incurs one 10-faith conflict; formally end one pact, then defend villagers to restore it.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.velkan: Ash Bargain: Health is sacrificed on signing, the release penalty is steep, and Ashen Strike also spends current health.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.urgen: Mountain Oath: Gain strength, defense, mining skill and two heavy melee powers.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.ridna: Lost Star Oath: Step only into safe space, then follow with a starlight strike.

message.anomalousclasses.pact.shero_warn: An observed enemy has locked onto you.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.karda: Storm Covenant: Offer copper and amethyst at the Horns of Storm. Leap and strike with thunder.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.nerea: Deep-Sea Covenant: Offer prismarine at the Sunken Hall. Tide and pressure work on land as well. Deliberately destroying your own abyssal altar core weakens affinity once. Reconcile it by landing underwater tide-to-pressure combos on real hostiles. Ordinary mining, fishing and sailing are not prohibited.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.shero: Observer Covenant: Offer ender pearls at the Eyeless Observatory and anticipate hostile threats.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.hastel: Ledger Covenant: Offer gold and emeralds at the Closed Counting Hall. Powers create battle debt that must be repaid before release. Alternatively settle outstanding debt once for one gold ingot per point; formal release penalties remain separate.
message.anomalousclasses.pact.trial_requ: Before signing with %s, prove yourself in this sanctuary. Aim at the altar and use /pact challenge.
message.anomalousclasses.pact.trial_aim: Aim at a tier-three or tier-four altar core within 8 blocks.
message.anomalousclasses.pact.trial_comp: The sanctuary accepts your victory. Return to the altar to review the covenant.

message.anomalousclasses.pact.trial_inva: The guardian cannot find safe ground to appear.
message.anomalousclasses.pact.trial_star: The sanctuary guardian rises. Defeat it to prove your right to a covenant.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.sevenwing: Defeat the tribunal guardian at the Court of Seven Lights. Harming innocent villagers breaks the judge's trust.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.merzad: Win the ordeal at the Extinguished Crown Court. Royal Flame burns foes even without a mark and punishes marked foes more.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.taron: Defeat the monolith guardian at the Throne of Black Mountains. Mountain Sunder remains usable without stone armor.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.arken: Defeat the watcher in the Sealed Archive. You can record up to two observed attacks; the arcane strike works even with no records.
message.anomalousclasses.pact.fate_refus: The First Oath denies death. Two gold blocks have been spent.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.nahar: Defeat the trial at the Black Star Observatory. The celestial strike is powerful without a record and stronger after a true weapon hit.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.rakiel: Defeat the guardian of the First Oath. The blade strikes at once. Totems act first; Fate Refusal costs two gold blocks with a long cooldown.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.ormas: Prove yourself at the Hand of the Sleeping Continent. Skin shields your body; the quake works without it and does not destroy player builds.
pact_terms.anomalousclasses.viar: Overcome the trial at the First Forest Heart. Roots strike anywhere, and valid combat damage provides capped healing.
